Notes: Fixed. Email MFA was being skipped outright whenever SMTP was unconfigured, so the back office had no second factor at all. A platform role can no longer skip it for any reason; a school leader still can, so an unreachable mailbox cannot lock a school out of its own workspace. Code is 10-minute, 3 attempts, 3 codes per 15 minutes, single use. Without SMTP the mailer writes the code to the API server log. The sign-in page also read the challenge by matching the error wording and missed it; it now reads the MFA_REQUIRED code and names the channel it was sent on.

Function / Action: Every consequential action asks for a reason
Notes: Still passes, and now actually true of extend trial: that endpoint took no reason at all, while the dialog claimed one was logged. Reason is now required (min 5 chars) and written to the audit log.

Fixed. Five of the nine alert kinds existed; four did not. Added zero logins (live school, no sign-in for 14 days), migration blocked (job not moved in 48h — same rule as the migration workspace's own tile), backup failed (failed run in the last 7 days) and DSR deadline (inside the last week of the NDPA 30-day window). Each routes to its module. On the current dev data only the DSR alert has anything to report; the other three are correctly quiet.

Fixed. The watch showed only open DSRs and unresolved incidents. It now also reads the obligations register: NDPC registration, DPO, DPIA and the annual audit filing, each with its countdown, plus a Next filing line. An unresolved breach is forced red regardless of how much of the 72 hours is left and is labelled CANNOT BE SET ASIDE.

No change. Separately noted: this fetch has no error handling, so the whole Command Center page errors for any platform role without finance rights (seen with Support Agent). Not in scope here — raise as its own defect.

Fixed — 'page reloads everytime a filter is done'. The filter bar was a plain HTML form doing a GET submit, which is a full document navigation. It now hands the query to the router, so the server component re-renders in place: the caret stays in the search box, the scroll position holds, and the bar says 'Filtering…' while it waits. The form keeps its action, so it still works with JavaScript off. Filters no longer stack a history entry each, and changing a filter resets to page 1.

Fixed — 'there is no extend trial on the list'. Extend trial (reason) added to the row menu. It appears only on a school that is on a trial or in grace, because the endpoint moves the school onto TRIAL and offering it on a paying school would be offering to undo the sale; the endpoint now refuses that too. Test it on a trial school. 'View details' is served by 'Open school profile' — the profile page is the detail view, and a second near-identical entry was not added.

Function / Action: Step 1 — school details and web address
Notes: Fixed — 'taken names are not rejected'. The wizard compared against three hard-coded names in the browser and never asked the server; the address was also never checked before Continue, and was then thrown away on submit. It now calls the registry on every keystroke (debounced), blocks Continue on anything not confirmed free, and offers three free alternatives as one-click chips. Two holes behind it: the registry only looked at its own table, which is empty, so it now checks School.slug and subdomain as well; and the format rule rejected hyphens, which every real address uses. Verified: greenfield-college is refused with suggestions, waec is refused as reserved, powerhouse is free. Also on this step, reported separately: the State dropdown offered 4 of Nigeria's 37 states and the country 3 of the 49 the product knows, the LGA was free text with no list behind it, and the LGA was thrown away on submit so School.lga was empty on every school made here. Country, state and LGA now come from the shared geography data (all 774 LGAs by state); labels follow the country, changing a state clears the LGA under it, and the LGA is saved.

Fixed. No invitation was ever sent: the account was created with the shared password FutureRealm123! and passwordResetRequired, so every school made from the back office had the same known password. It now gets a random unusable password and a real single-use invitation token valid exactly 24 hours. The WhatsApp and SMS chips were discarded on submit — only sendWelcomeEmail was sent — so all three channels are now carried, attempted separately, and what actually left is recorded in the audit log rather than assumed. Verified end to end: token expiry exactly 24h, unconsumed, and the audit entry records each channel's real outcome.
